metaTitle: Video Frame Grabber - Save Any Frame as PNG (Free) | ReelFlow Toolkit
description: Scrub any video, pick the exact second and download that frame as a full-size PNG. Processed in your browser.
ogTitle: Video Frame Grabber - A PNG at Any Second
ogDescription: Save any frame of a video as a full-resolution PNG without uploading the file.
ldDescription: Select a time in a video and export that frame as a PNG image using the browser canvas.
lede: Load a video, move to the exact second and save that frame as a PNG. The image keeps the full resolution of the video.

faq.a: You can step the time in fractions of a second. The browser seeks to the nearest frame it can decode, so the saved image matches what the preview shows.
The full resolution of the video - a 1920x1080 clip gives a 1920x1080 PNG. No scaling is applied.

faq.q: Does it work for every format?
faq.a: Any video the browser can play. MP4 with H.264 works everywhere; MOV and MKV depend on the browser's codecs.
